briefing.title: GENESIS
story: The defenses fall. The towers sing in harmony. The binding holds firm, and Aether Prime
settles into a new equilibrium — not the sleep of ages, but the waking rest of a god
that has learned consent, learned partnership with the fragile things that walk its crust.
But there is one last threat. The Chorus itself has fragments, splinters of consciousness
that were never part of the binding. They rage at the edges of the planet, calling to the
deep places, trying to break free. One final push, one last battle. Then, peace.
SERA VANE: "This is it. Everything we've fought for comes down to this single moment.
Take the field. Seal the cracks in the world. End this war. And let something new begin."
objectives: Achieve total victory — destroy all enemy forces
Secure the genesis point (control the center of the map for 60s)

win: The last fragments of Aether Prime's fractured consciousness are sealed away,
integrated into the binding, made whole. The planet rests, truly rests, for the first time
in a thousand years. And on its surface, two factions — enemies for so long — stand
together in the ruins of the old world, looking toward something new.
MARSHAL CORR: "We came to fight a god. We leave as something more — something that
helped create the world that's coming next."
SERA VANE: "The war is over. The real work begins now. Aether Prime is listening.
Let's give it something worth hearing."
lose: The fragments break free. The binding shatters like glass. Aether Prime wakes
fully, and in that waking, the world ends. You fought with honor, fought with courage —
but some things are too powerful, too vast, to ever truly defeat.
Your sacrifice will echo in the ruins, remembered by no one.
